notes: Two review reasons. (1) do_xmlattr's only reference is the FILTERS dict literal (src/jinja2/filters.py:1852). defaults.py:3 imports FILTERS as DEFAULT_FILTERS, Environment.__init__ copies it into self.filters (environment.py:351), and the filter runs from compiled template code (CodeGenerator.pull_dependencies, compiler.py:538, emits t_N = environment.filters['xmlattr'] at :570, called at the |xmlattr use site) or from Environment.call_filter (:549) -> _filter_test_common (self.filters.get(name) at :512, called at :547). Compiled code runs from Template.render (root_render_func at :1302), render_async (:1324), generate (:1355), generate_async (:1373), stream (via generate, :1333), make_module (TemplateModule, :1408) and make_module_async (:1425). No sandbox is needed for the injection, so plain Environment and Template are listed with the sandbox classes. (2) module_level jinja2.filters (src/jinja2/filters.py): the changed module statement is _space_re = re.compile(r'\s') (:253), whose only use is inside do_xmlattr (:292), so it is reached exactly when do_xmlattr is; the same entry points cover it and the paths end at do_xmlattr. Checked against the record's tree a7863ba (3.1.3-8-ga7863ba9, first parent of the fix) on 2026-11-04.
